Hughes stock was not listed on a national exchange or quoted on the National Association Securities Dealers (NASD) automated quotation system (NASDAQ). Instead, the stock was listed in the “pink sheets.”¹² Individual investors rarely have access to the pink sheets and the information in the pink sheets is not very helpful. The pink sheets contain the names of broker-dealer firms making a market in the stock. Most firms are listed in name only and do not provide bid and ask quotations.
